dedupe_keys.name: wasd measured lte 5g signals with synthetic anomaly overlays

description: WASD combines measured cellular radio signals with synthetic tone, chirp and pulse anomalies for spectrum-monitoring experiments. Chungnam National University’s REMI Lab documents 85,500 spectrogram samples across 19 LTE and 5G bands, with bounding boxes and interference-to-signal information. Published formats include binary IQ samples with JSON metadata, NumPy spectrogram arrays and CSV labels. Coverage is fixed urban radio environments; precise geographic extent and the full acquisition calendar are not established in the inspected metadata. The canonical IEEE DataPort dataset is free open access for registered users, and DataCite specifies CC BY 4.0. The repository code separately reports GPL 3.0 and links full-release Drive chunks. A limitation is inconsistent calibration wording on the DataPort page, which describes offsets using dB and dBµV and reference levels using dBm and dBmV. Units must be resolved before quantitative power calibration. Simulation uses include testing anomaly detection and synthetic interference scenarios. No related catalogue resource was identified as the same campaign. The approximately 140,000 labels count anomaly boxes, not independent spectrograms. Public metadata and the lab viewer were checked; no account login, data download or notebook execution was needed.
